description: Angular component for notification setting form, managing notification preferences including delivery methods and template types.

classes.name: NotificationSettingFormComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing ControlValueAccessor for notification settings form, handling form state, input bindings, and change propagation.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers callback for propagating changes to the form model.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Placeholder for registering touch callback (not implemented).

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form group and sets up value change subscription.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Unsubscribes from value change subscription to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form based on input.

methods.name: getChecked
methods.description: Returns whether a specific delivery method is enabled; updates overall enabled state accordingly.

methods.name: toggleDeliviryMethod
methods.description: Toggles the enabled state of a specific delivery method.

methods.name: changeInstanceTypeCheckBox
methods.description: Sets all delivery methods to a specified boolean value.

methods.name: getIndeterminate
methods.description: Determines if the checkbox state should be indeterminate based on delivery methods.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Populates the form with a given notification user setting value.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Propagates form value changes to the parent component.
